limits: Keyless feeds sample recent swaps in selected trending pools; not full-chain or full-wallet histories.
DexScreener scouts markets; GeckoTerminal supplies recent swap observations. Public RPC checks only a small transaction sample. GMGN and Solscan are links only.
Matched-sell win rates and FIFO P&L are estimates on observed lots, NOT account returns. Fees, token taxes, transfers and prior holdings omitted.
Monthly observations are partial; missing months are UNKNOWN, not zero. A few minutes of data cannot demonstrate consistent monthly profits.

No historical entry market cap or true peak is available. Copy scoring uses weighted FIFO matched holding windows and sparse observed prices, not verified insider timing. A 3x move means +200%, not +300%.
Bot and cluster heuristics are incomplete and can misclassify. No wallet is proven an insider; no guarantee of profitable copying.
Copy capture is retrospective best sampled exit, not an execution backtest. Delay, each-way slippage and current liquidity impact are configurable; no guarantee a follower captures 35–50%.
APIs are rate-limited and may omit trades. Hourly polling misses activity; first enabled alert cycle is an observation baseline.
